summary: Updates, support work and daily runs no longer get in each other's way.

fixes.title: Updates are no longer held by support work
fixes.text: A support step no longer starts the database setup during an update, and an update now waits only for its own setup. A busy database is retried.

fixes.title: Runs are not cut short by updates
fixes.text: Right before an update starts, it checks again whether a run has begun and warns when the next run is minutes away. An update started by hand waits for a run that just started.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: A run retries a short network error while reading its settings. The data fresh start retries a temporary refusal and is much faster.
